## Code signals (mid-build detector, S5)
- Growing tables or media storage
  - code: `\b(logs?|events?|history|uploads?|media)\b.*\bmodel\b|\bmodel (Log|Event|History|Media|Upload)\w*\b`
  - code: `@aws-sdk/client-s3|minio|@google-cloud/storage`
